title: Back-to-Back Meeting Compression
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:event meeting_status=completed start_epoch=* end_epoch=*
| sort 0 start_epoch
| streamstats current=f last(end_epoch) as prev_end by attendee
| eval gap_minutes=round((start_epoch-prev_end)/60,1)
| where isnotnull(prev_end) AND gap_minutes<5
| stats count as compressed_meetings, avg(gap_minutes) as avg_gap_minutes by attendee
| sort - compressed_meetings
description: Counts meetings that start with less than five minutes of breathing room after the previous one.
value: Calendar compression is one of the clearest observable drivers of fatigue in home-office knowledge work.
implementation: Export meeting start and end timestamps and group the resulting low-gap handoffs by attendee.
visualization: Table of attendees with compressed meeting count and average gap.
grandmaExplanation: It spots who keeps getting slammed with one meeting right after another with hardly any pause.
